stem:
The population of Center City is modeled by exponential function f, where x is the number of years after the year 2015. The graph of f is shown on the grid.

Which inequality best represents the range of f in this situation?
visual_elements: Graph labeled 'Center City' with y-axis labeled 'Population' ranging from 0 to 900,000 in increments of 100,000, and x-axis labeled 'Time After 2015 (years)' from 0 to 100 in increments of 20, showing an upward curve starting near 250,000 at x=0 and increasing exponentially.
